stages.prompt: Read the item and tree. To divide the work, write the optional proposal output targeting work with workflow build-pieces@v1 and args.pieces, a list of at most 12 objects in execution order. Each object has id, seat, access (read_only or write), prompt, optional outputs mapping names to types, and for write access a nonempty write_scope within the item's fence. Read-only pieces must omit write_scope. Choose seats mapped by policy and do not assign writes to read-only seats. If no division is useful, propose nothing. Do not write or commit repository files.
